text:
Sam B: Quick sync on AcmePay POC — they're evaluating a migration from CompetitorX and hit a few blockers. Need a checklist: security questionnaire, pricing differences, prompt/response parity tests, webhook/signature behavior, and any network whitelists. Can SEs and security advise? cc @Ravi K @Alyssa S
Ravi K: Got it. Do we know which endpoints they currently call (streaming vs non-streaming)? Also: do they expect exact token-level parity or semantic parity?
Sam B: Mostly synchronous generate and embeddings today. They care more about semantic parity for UX, but legal wants to understand billing deltas.
Alyssa S: Pricing note — they asked if we can mirror CompetitorX's per-request SKU vs our per-token model for the POC. Short answer: we can provide an estimated per-run quote for the trial (timeboxed), but production will be usage-based. I'll draft a one-off POC quote.
Marta Sec: Security prelim questions: will customer data stay in-region? Do they require SAML SSO for the console? Do they want customer-managed KMS or HSM? Any webhook signing verification? Please share their security questionnaire PDF and estimated throughput (rps). Link to our SOC2/KMS docs: https://redwood.example/security-pack
Devon CS: For acceptance criteria, propose: 1) prompt fidelity smoke: 1k representative prompts, 2) latency p95 < 250ms for single-shot gen (hosted), 3) billing delta < 15% on the POC workloads, 4) webhooks/retries match expected semantics. We'll run the eval harness.
Ravi K: Proposed technical plan (3 phases):
1) Handshake & auth (2 days): validate auth flow, webhook signature, sample cURLs, IP/KMS whitelists.
2) Parity smoke (3 days): run side-by-side 1k prompts, collect token counts, BLEU/ROUGE-style metrics + human spot checks.
3) Scale & SLA smoke (2–3 days): ramp to expected rps and check fallbacks.
Ravi K: Example handshake commands (for their engineers):
```
# exchange token
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/auth/token -d '{"client_id":"ACME123","client_secret":"..."}'
# generate
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rw-large-1","input":"Hello"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Ravi K: Small test vector excerpt: `["What is my last transaction?","Summarize latest invoice"]` — we will run these against CompetitorX and Redwood and surface deltas.
Marta Sec: Also need to confirm TLS modes: do they require mTLS for callbacks? If yes, we'll enable mutual auth on Private/Dedicated; Hosted may need IP+signature.
kms-bot: KMS notice: customer-managed keys supported for Private deployments and Dedicated with enterprise plan. See docs: https://redwood.example/kms
Alyssa S: I'll prepare the POC quote and include a one-off per-run estimate. Can someone flag any non-negotiable compliance asks from AcmePay before I send?
Sam B: They flagged: data residency in eu-west, SAML SSO, and an audit log export cadence.
Devon CS: I'll own the eval harness runs and produce the initial report (grid with BLEU/latency/token-delta). Target: deliver by next Thu if we start Mon.
Ravi K: I'll take the handshake and test vector work; need Acme's sample API traffic (anonymized) and their webhook spec.
Marta Sec: I'll coordinate the questionnaire and run a quick threat surface review. Need point of contact to share docs (SFTP or secure upload).
Alyssa S: Proposed timeline: kickoff Mon (3/29), handshake Tue-Wed, parity Thu-Fri, scale next Mon. I'll put this in a calendar invite. :calendar:
Sam B: Perfect. Owners: Ravi (tech lead), Devon (eval), Marta (security), Alyssa (commercial). Sam will coordinate with Acme. Anything else?
Ravi K: One more minor thing — CompetitorX signs callbacks using header X-CX-Signature (HMAC-SHA256). We should confirm Redwood's signature header and include mapping in the handshake doc.
Marta Sec: Noted. I'll add signature mapping and IDS rules to the checklist.
Sam B: Thanks all — I'll message Acme for their questionnaire and sample prompts now. :thumbsup:
